newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Police want iced Israeli mother out of freezer.
newsitem.headline: Police want iced Israeli mother out of freezer.

text.p: Moshe Beeri has his late mother at home on ice and Israeli police are not pleased.

The 70-year-old woman died two weeks ago. Beeri has been keeping her in the freezer of their apartment in central Israel hoping scientists will one day find a way to bring her back to life, Israel Radio said on Sunday.

"It's very hard for me to part from her physically and emotionally. This is her will and ours as well because it's the only way we know to give her a chance to return someday," Beeri told reporters on Sunday outside a courtroom where police asked judges to order the mother's burial.
The decision was postponed to a later date.
